add.name: High camp above the Blue Glacier
add.capacity: A few small tent sites on rock and heather knolls
add.water: Snowmelt and small streams in the upper Blue basin
add.permit: No overnight permit required in Glacier Peak Wilderness; sign the trailhead register
add.notes: Reached from Stehekin by the shuttle to High Bridge, about ten miles up the Agnes Creek trail, a log crossing of Agnes Creek and a long bushwhack into the upper Blue basin. Camp sits on an exposed rock ridge above the Blue Glacier, directly below the east side of the Gunsight peaks.

routes.note: Stored approach is from Stehekin via Agnes Creek, so none of the Downey Creek or traverse camps lie on it; the added camp's elevation is not published and is omitted.
